name: motif_add_stem_name
description:
Author a stem name. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use only if a stem's form depends on the word's inflection features, such as a past-tense stem; otherwise use environments for sound, or an inflection class for stem groups. Attach it with compose-edit-stem-allomorph-stem-name (guide conditioned-allomorphs). Adds a category-owned stem name with explicit feature regions to a Draft. Each region states where an allomorph bearing this stem name is eligible; attaching it to an allomorph is a separate operation.
Command: compose-author-stem-name. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The Draft to append the authored operations to.
IntentJson: The closed stem name input, resolved against the prepared Draft.

category.description: Canonical id of the category owning this stem name.

ws.description: Writing system tag for the name and abbreviation.

feature.description: Closed feature id in the morphosyntactic system.

value.description: Value id belonging to that feature.

items.description: Nonempty choices; one value for each feature.

regions.description: Nonempty feature regions permitting the named stem.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
